parameters.name: DbNodeIds
parameters.description: 目标PolarDB集群下对应的节点列表，不同集群的节点间用英文逗号（,）分组，组内节点用英文冒号（:）隔开。

parameters.name: Weights
parameters.description: PolarDB分组对应的权重，多个权重间用英文逗号（,）隔开。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds modify-polar-db-read-weight --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --db-name test --db-node-ids pi-0000000000000000,pi-0000000000000000:pi-0000000000000000 --db-instance-id pc-0000000000000000 --weights 14,86 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds ModifyPolarDbReadWeight --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000000 --Weights '14,86' --DbNodeIds 'pi-0000000000000000,pi-0000000000000000:pi-0000000000000000' --DbName test --DbInstanceId 'pc-0000000000000000'
